Read ACO (Airspace Colour) File — read_aco
text: function parses SAAM .aco files. files link specific airblocks (often defined Sector:Airblock composite names) visual properties like RGB color, transparency, display flags. file structure defined follows: Extension: aco Origin: SAAM Separator: Whitespace Record Structure: Field 1: Version (Format version, usually 1). Field 2: Airblock Name (Format: Sector:Airblock just Airblock). Field 3: Flight Level Bottom (Padded 0, e.g., 085). Field 4: Flight Level Top (Padded 0). Field 5: Nb Colours (Number color definitions following). Field 6: Colour Version. Field 7: Colour Name ("?" default). Field 8: Feature Code (Bitmask display flags, see details). Field 9: Colour Flag (1=Defined , 0=Inherited). Field 10: Type (Usually "C"). Field 11: Transparency (0-255). Field 12: Red (0-255). Field 13: Green (0-255). Field 14: Blue (0-255).

title: Read ACO (Airspace Colour) File — read_aco
text: aco_file Path .aco file.

title: Read ACO (Airspace Colour) File — read_aco
text: data.table following columns: airblock_name: Character (raw ID file). fl_bottom: Integer. fl_top: Integer. feature_code: Integer (Bitmask). transparency: Integer. red: Integer. green: Integer. blue: Integer. hex: Character (Derived hex color string convenience, e.g., "#RRGGBB").

title: Read ACO (Airspace Colour) File — read_aco
text: Reads .aco file defining display attributes (colors, transparency, flags) 3D airblocks.

what: Read ARE (Newmaxo ASCII Region) File — read_are
title: Read ARE (Newmaxo ASCII Region) File — read_are
text: function parses SAAM/Newmaxo .files. files define 2D geometry airblocks. file structured repeating sequence Header line followed multiple Body lines (vertices). Extension: Origin: Newmaxo, SAAM, CAPAN Separator: Blank (whitespace) Header Line (Metadata): Field 1: Number points (vertices) Field 2-3: Label latitude/longitude (Center label, vertex) Field 4-14: Attributes (Levels, flags, colors) Field 15: Volume Name (Airblock ID) Body Line (Geometry): Field 1: Latitude (minutes) Field 2: Longitude (minutes)

title: Read ARE (Newmaxo ASCII Region) File — read_are
Read ARE (Newmaxo ASCII Region) File — read_are
text: are_file Path .file.

title: Read ARE (Newmaxo ASCII Region) File — read_are
text: data.table ordered sequence, containing: volume_id: identifier airblock/volume. lat: Latitude decimal degrees. lon: Longitude decimal degrees. sequence: original ordering points (crucial polygon closure).

title: Read ARE (Newmaxo ASCII Region) File — read_are
text: Reads .file defining coordinates (vertices) airblocks/volumes.

title: Read ARP (Airport Definition) File — read_arp
text: function parses .arp files, provide simple definition airport locations used SAAM assignment processes. file structure defined follows: Extension: arp Origin: Manual input Separator: Whitespace Coordinate Unit: Minutes (Decimal) Record Structure: Field 1: Airport ICAO (4 characters) Field 2: Latitude (Minutes) Field 3: Longitude (Minutes) Field 4: FIR Name (Optional, e.g., "EGTT_FIR" "NOFIR")

title: Read ARP (Airport Definition) File — read_arp
text: arp_file Path .arp file.

title: Read ARP (Airport Definition) File — read_arp
text: data.table following columns: icao: Character (4-letter ICAO code). lat: Numeric (Latitude Decimal Degrees). lon: Numeric (Longitude Decimal Degrees). fir_id: Character (associated Flight Information Region).

title: Read ARP (Airport Definition) File — read_arp
text: Reads .arp file defining geographical location FIR association airports.

title: Read AWK (RAD Rule) File — read_awk
text: function parses SAAM .awk files. handles hierarchical structure, nested logic blocks, extracts Routing constraints. Structure: Sections (#SECTION) Rule Headers (#RAD) Logic Lines (... REGLE=REGLE ...)

title: Read AWK (RAD Rule) File — read_awk
text: awk_file Path .awk file. parse_rules Logical. TRUE, extracts structured columns: condition_dep, condition_arr, condition_rfl_min, condition_rfl_max, routing_constraint.

title: Read AWK (RAD Rule) File — read_awk
text: data.table. parse_rules = TRUE, columns include: condition_dep/arr/...: Regex patterns. exclude_dep/arr/...: Logical flags negation. condition_rfl_min/max: Integer limits Requested Flight Level. routing_constraint: routing string (e.g., " - BUGOR DERAD").

title: Read AWK (RAD Rule) File — read_awk
text: Reads .awk file defining RAD Routing Rules.

title: Read CFG (Configuration) File — read_cfg
text: function parses SAAM/Gasel .cfg files. files define elementary sectors airspaces grouped operational configurations (e.g., "CONF1", "Night_Config") specific ACC (Area Control Center) airspace family. file structure defined follows: Extension: cfg Origin: Gasel, SAAM Separator: Semicolon (;) Sort: family/ACC name, configuration name. file consists : First Line: Metadata starting # (e.g., version, dates, record count). Body Lines: Records linking ACC/Family Configuration specific Sector. Record Structure: Field 1: ACC Name (Family Grouping ID) Field 2: Configuration Name (ID specific configuration) Field 3: Sector Name (component included configuration)

title: Read CFG (Configuration) File — read_cfg
text: cfg_file Path .cfg file.

title: Read CFG (Configuration) File — read_cfg
text: data.table following columns: acc_id: identifier ACC Airspace Family. config_id: name configuration. sector_id: identifier sector belonging configuration.

title: Read CFG (Configuration) File — read_cfg
text: Reads .cfg file defining Air Traffic Control (ATC) configurations sector compositions.

title: Read COS (Opening Scheme) File — read_cos
text: function parses SAAM/Gasel .cos files. files determine configuration (defined .cfg files) active specific ACC/Airspace specific time window. file structure defined follows: Extension: cos Origin: Gasel, SAAM Separator: Semicolon (;) Sort: period, family, start time. file consists : First Line: Metadata starting # (e.g., version, dates). Body Lines: Records defining schedule. Record Structure: Field 1: Date (dd/MM/yyyy) Field 2: ACC Name (Family/Group ID) Field 3: Start Time (hh:mm) Field 4: End Time (hh:mm) Field 5: Configuration Name (ID active configuration) Field 6: Origin ('E' = Environment/Planned, 'T' = Tactical/Actual)

title: Read COS (Opening Scheme) File — read_cos
text: cos_file Path .cos file.

title: Read COS (Opening Scheme) File — read_cos
text: data.table following columns: date: Date object (Date class). acc_id: identifier ACC/Family. start_time: Character (hh:mm). end_time: Character (hh:mm). config_id: identifier configuration. origin_type: Character ('E' 'T').

title: Read COS (Opening Scheme) File — read_cos
text: Reads .cos file defining operational opening scheme (schedule) configurations.

title: Read FLC2 (Rule/Constraint) File — read_flc2
text: function parses SAAM .flc2 files. handles: Hierarchical Sections Rule headers. Nested Logic Blocks: Handles (...) { ... } structures flattening logic. Syntax Variations: Supports Regex (~ /.../) String Equality (== "...").

title: Read FLC2 (Rule/Constraint) File — read_flc2
text: flc2_file Path .flc2 file. parse_rules Logical. TRUE, extracts structured columns.

title: Read FLC2 (Rule/Constraint) File — read_flc2
text: data.table. parse_rules = TRUE, following columns added: condition_dep, condition_arr, condition_point, condition_via, condition_climb_rate: Regex patterns exact strings. exclude_dep, exclude_arr, etc.: Logical flags (TRUE condition negated '!'). constraint_type: "ROUTING" (REGLE), "MAX", "MIN", "EQUAL" (FL_CONT). constraint_value: routing string (type ROUTING) Flight Level (integer).

title: Read FLC2 (Rule/Constraint) File — read_flc2
text: Reads .flc2 (.awk) file defining RAD Rules.

title: Read MOT (Airspace Activation) File — read_mot
text: function parses SAAM .mot files (Military Opening Time). files define specific airspaces (usually military zones Free Route Airspace) active available civil traffic. file structure supports three format versions, indicated first field: Version 1: Basic activation (Zone, Start, End). Version 2: Level restricted (Zone, Start, End, Min FL, Max FL). Version 3: Type restricted (Zone, Start, End, Opening Type). Record Structure: Field 1: Version (1, 2, 3). Field 2: Zone Name (Must match SLS/Map definitions). Field 3: Start Time (HHMM). Field 4: End Time (HHMM). Field 5: Lower FL (Ver 2) Opening Type (Ver 3). Field 6: Upper FL (Ver 2 ).

title: Read MOT (Airspace Activation) File — read_mot
text: mot_file Path .mot file.

title: Read MOT (Airspace Activation) File — read_mot
text: data.table following columns: version: Integer (1, 2, 3). zone_id: Character. start_time: Character (HHMM). end_time: Character (HHMM). min_fl: Integer (NA Ver 1 & 3). max_fl: Integer (NA Ver 1 & 3). opening_type: Character (NA Ver 1 & 2. e.g., "EX", "E").

title: Read MOT (Airspace Activation) File — read_mot
text: Reads .mot file defining airspace activation times, flight levels, opening types.

title: Read NARP (Airport) File — read_narp
text: function parses SAAM/Gasel .narp files. files contain comprehensive list airports, including ICAO codes, names, coordinates, traffic sequencing parameters. file structure defined follows: Extension: narp Separator: Semicolon (;) Coordinate System: Decimal degrees file consists : First Line: Metadata starting # (e.g., version, dates, record count). Body Lines: Records defining individual airports. Record Structure: Field 1: ICAO Code (4 characters) Field 2: Airport Name Field 3: Latitude (Decimal Degrees) Field 4: Longitude (Decimal Degrees) Field 5: TIS (Time Insert Sequence - minutes) Field 6: TRS (Time Remove Sequence - minutes) Field 7: Taxi Time (minutes) Field 8: Altitude (Flight Levels) Note TIS/TRS: Underscores ("_") numeric fields (TIS, TRS, TaxiTime) indicate missing data converted NA.

title: Read NARP (Airport) File — read_narp
text: narp_file Path .narp file.

title: Read NARP (Airport) File — read_narp
text: data.table following columns: icao: Character (4-letter ICAO code). name: Character (Airport name). lat: Numeric (Latitude). lon: Numeric (Longitude). tis: Numeric (Time Insert). trs: Numeric (Time Remove). taxitime: Numeric. altitude: Numeric (Flight Level).

title: Read NARP (Airport) File — read_narp
text: Reads .narp file defining airport metadata, location, operational parameters.

title: Read NNPT (Navigation Point) File — read_nnpt
text: function parses .nnpt files used define navigation points (waypoints, VORs, NDBs, etc.). file structure defined follows: Extension: nnpt Separator: Semicolon (;) Coordinate System: Decimal degrees file consists : First Line: integer representing total number records. Subsequent Lines: Records containing point definition. Record Structure: Field 1: ID (e.g., *01BP) Field 2: Type (e.g., DB) Field 3: Latitude (Decimal Degrees) Field 4: Longitude (Decimal Degrees) Field 5: Name (Underscore "_" indicates data)

title: Read NNPT (Navigation Point) File — read_nnpt
text: nnpt_file Path .nnpt file.

title: Read NNPT (Navigation Point) File — read_nnpt
text: data.table following columns: point_id: unique identifier navigation point. type: type classification point. lat: Latitude decimal degrees. lon: Longitude decimal degrees. name: descriptive name (NA original "_").

title: Read NNPT (Navigation Point) File — read_nnpt
text: Reads .nnpt file containing list navigation points coordinates.

title: Read NTFV (Traffic Volume) File — read_ntfv
text: function parses SAAM/Gasel .ntfv files. files define "Traffic Volumes" (TVs), groupings flights (flows) passing specific points airspaces. file structure hierarchical: Extension: ntfv Separator: Semicolon (;) file consists : First Line: Metadata starting #. Traffic Volume Headers (T): Define volume properties. number fields varies location type. Flow Element Lines (F): Define specific flows included/excluded volume. Header Types: Type 1 (AD/AZ): 8 Fields. (FL Skip info). Type 2 (/SP/DBP): 10 Fields. Includes Min/Max FL Skip /times. Common Fields (T): ID, Name, Category (MO/_), Ref Location Name, Ref Location Type (AD, AZ, , SP, DBP), Role (D, , G), Nb Elements. Variable Fields (T): /SP/DBP: Field 8 (Min FL / Skip ), Field 9 (Max FL / Skip ). Flow Lines (F): Field 2: Flow Element ID Field 3: Flow Type (, IE, EX, EM)

title: Read NTFV (Traffic Volume) File — read_ntfv
text: ntfv_file Path .ntfv file.

title: Read NTFV (Traffic Volume) File — read_ntfv
text: data.table following columns: tv_id: Traffic Volume ID. tv_name: Traffic Volume Name/Description. tv_category: Category (e.g., MO). ref_loc_name: Reference Location Name. ref_loc_type: Reference Location Type (AD, AZ, , SP, DBP). ref_loc_role: Reference Role (D, , G). min_fl_or_skip_in: Min Flight Level Skip time (Numeric). max_fl_or_skip_out: Max Flight Level Skip time (Numeric). flow_id: ID flow element (Child). flow_type: type flow element (, EX, etc.).

title: Read NTFV (Traffic Volume) File — read_ntfv
text: Reads .ntfv file defining traffic volumes flow elements.

title: Read PNL (Penalisation/Segment) File — read_pnl
text: function parses SAAM/Gasel .pnl files. Unlike .tax files (define turn penalties), .pnl files define penalty (Nautical Miles) traversing specific straight-line segment two points. file structure defined follows: Extension: pnl Separator: One spaces (Whitespace) Comments: Lines starting // ignored. Record Structure: Field 1: Point 1 (Start segment) Field 2: Point 2 (End segment) Field 3: Penalisation (Cost NM)

title: Read PNL (Penalisation/Segment) File — read_pnl
text: pnl_file Path .pnl file.

title: Read PNL (Penalisation/Segment) File — read_pnl
text: data.table following columns: start_point: identifier starting point. end_point: identifier ending point. penalty: Numeric. added cost (NM) using segment.

title: Read PNL (Penalisation/Segment) File — read_pnl
text: Reads .pnl file defining penalizations (costs) specific network segments.

what: Read RLEX (Route Length Extension Exception) File — read_rlex
title: Read RLEX (Route Length Extension Exception) File — read_rlex
text: function parses SAAM/Gasel .rlex files. files specify exceptions standard route length validation rules, allowing specific departure-arrival pairs defined route length extension (Nautical Miles). file structure defined follows: Extension: rlex Origin: Produced manually Separator: Whitespace (Space Tab) Record Structure: Field 1: ADEP (Departure Airport ICAO) Field 2: ADES (Arrival Airport ICAO) Field 3: Allowed Extension (Numeric, NM)

title: Read RLEX (Route Length Extension Exception) File — read_rlex
Read RLEX (Route Length Extension Exception) File — read_rlex
text: rlex_file Path .rlex file.

title: Read RLEX (Route Length Extension Exception) File — read_rlex
text: data.table following columns: adep: Departure airport ICAO code. ades: Arrival airport ICAO code. allowed_extension: allowed extension Nautical Miles.

title: Read RLEX (Route Length Extension Exception) File — read_rlex
text: Reads .rlex file defining allowed route length extensions airport pairs.

title: Read RTS (Routes) File — read_routes
text: function parses SAAM/Gasel .rts files. files define structure airways (routes) listing sequence points (waypoints, VORs, etc.) comprise . file structure defined follows: Extension: rts Separator: Semicolon (;) Sort: route name, sequence number. file consists : First Line: Metadata starting #. Body Lines (L): Records defining point route. Record Structure (L lines): Field 1: L (Link/Line indicator) Field 2: Route Name (e.g., A1, A100) Field 3: Type (Usually "AR" Airway Route) Field 4: Time (Validity Start - often 0000...) Field 5: Time (Validity End - often 9999...) Field 6: Point ID (navigation point name) Field 7: Point Type (e.g., SP, DBP, VTR) Field 8: Sequence Number (Order point route)

title: Read RTS (Routes) File — read_routes

title: Read RUNWAY File — read_runway
text: function parses SAAM/Gasel .runway files. files define runways (QFU) active specific airports specific dates, along operational parameters. file structure defined follows: Extension: runway Origin: Gasel, SAAM Separator: Semicolon (;) Sort: Date, Airport, QFU. file consists : First Line: Metadata starting #. Body Lines: Records defining runway usage. Record Structure: Field 1: Date (dd/MM/yyyy) Field 2: Airport ICAO (4 chars) Field 3: QFU (Runway Designator, e.g., 29C, 06) Field 4: Start Time (HHMM) Field 5: End Time (HHMM) Field 6: Default (Y/N - default runway configuration?) Field 7: Taxi Time (Minutes) Field 8: TIS (Time Insert Sequence - Minutes) Field 9: TRS (Time Remove Sequence - Minutes) Field 10: Origin (E=Environment/Planned, T=Tactical/Actual)
